title: Pachymic acid suppresses proliferation and invasion in colon cancer by inhibiting glycolysis via PPARgamma/ENO1 pathway.
authors: Wang, Zhiwei; Wu, Peiyao; Zhang, Chuanzhuo; Zhang, Ting; Gu, Chunlin; Xie, Xiaodong; Feng, Xiao; Jiang, Zhiwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究茯苓酸通过PPARgamma/ENO1通路抑制结肠癌糖酵解与增殖侵袭，属纯肿瘤生物学与代谢研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Aerobic glycolysis constitutes a fundamental aspect of the process of tumor development. Pachymic acid, a major active ingredient in Poria cocos, has been reported to impair glucose metabolism in several cancers. However, whether pachymic acid could inhibit the aerobic glycolysis of colon cancer remains to be elucidated. Our study revealed that the treatment of pachymic acid significantly inhibited the proliferation and invasion of HT-29 and HCT-116 cells. Moreover, it led to a substantial reduction in the expression level of glycolysis-related proteins including phosphoglycerate kinase 1 (PGK1), glucose transporter 1 (GLUT1), lactate dehydrogenase A (LDHA) and alpha-enolase (ENO1). Potential targets of pachymic acid were screened by network pharmacology analysis and molecular docking, and PPARgamma was determined as the primary target of pachymic acid according to Western blot and real-time qPCR. Further experiments indicated that the overexpression of PPARgamma reversed the inhibitory effects of pachymic acid on the proliferation, invasion and aerobic glycolysis of HT-29 and HCT-116 cells. The inhibition of PPARgamma led to a significant reduction in the expression of PGK1, GLUT1, LDHA and ENO1. Subcutaneous tumor-bearing experiments in nude mice verified the antitumor effect of pachymic acid on colon cancer, which could be reversed by the overexpression of PPARgamma. The present study confirmed that pachymic acid played an inhibitory role in the proliferation and invasion of colon cancer by intervening in the process of glycolysis. PPARgamma was identified as the primary target of pachymic acid in regulating the glucose metabolism in colon cancer.
abstract_zh: 有氧糖酵解构成了肿瘤发展过程的一个基本方面。茯苓酸（Pachymic acid）是茯苓（Poria cocos）中的一种主要活性成分，已有报道称其可损害多种癌症中的葡萄糖代谢。然而，茯苓酸是否能抑制结肠癌的有氧糖酵解仍有待阐明。我们的研究表明，茯苓酸处理显著抑制了HT-29和HCT-116细胞的增殖和侵袭。此外，它还导致糖酵解相关蛋白表达水平大幅降低，包括磷酸甘油酸激酶1（PGK1）、葡萄糖转运蛋白1（GLUT1）、乳酸脱氢酶A（LDHA）和α-烯醇化酶（ENO1）。通过网络药理学分析和分子对接筛选了茯苓酸的潜在靶点，并根据Western blot和实时qPCR确定PPARgamma为茯苓酸的主要靶点。进一步实验表明，PPARgamma的过表达逆转了茯苓酸对HT-29和HCT-116细胞增殖、侵袭及有氧糖酵解的抑制作用。PPARgamma的抑制导致PGK1、GLUT1、LDHA和ENO1表达显著降低。裸鼠皮下荷瘤实验验证了茯苓酸对结肠癌的抗肿瘤作用，而这种作用可被PPARgamma的过表达所逆转。本研究证实，茯苓酸通过干预糖酵解过程在结肠癌的增殖和侵袭中发挥抑制作用。PPARgamma被确定为茯苓酸在调节结肠癌葡萄糖代谢中的主要靶点。
